answer: Make admission expensive and reputation unboughtable: each new identity must burn a proof-of-work and win a voucher who posts collateral, slashed if the recruit attacks. A sybil pays twice - compute per fake identity, burned stake per fake voucher - while earning nothing, since consensus weight accrues only after many verified epochs. Cheap identities stay hollow: they emit a signal, but no peer attests their transactions, so their votes are noise. Like a falcon that hunts alone yet returns each day, an identity earns standing by showing up, epoch after epoch, with work peers can check.
